title: AppShell
description: Application chrome: a collapsible or floating sidebar, a sticky header and a single main landmark; navigation moves into a drawer at 768px and below.

support.notes: Native view layouts, token-aware Box background/radius/shadow and numeric size resolution, spacing and attached controls, container-measured responsive grids/SplitLayout, sections/actions, compact/expanded/floating AppShell navigation and mobile drawer with route-change dismissal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. CSS as/asChild polymorphism is not native. Floating AppShell expands by touch rather than hover. Measurements initially use window width until the native selector query returns. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: AppShell
translationResources.description: Application chrome: a collapsible or floating sidebar, a sticky header and a single main landmark; navigation moves into a drawer at 768px and below.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: navigation is a render function receiving collapsed / isMobile / closeNavigation / expandNavigation.

controlled.title: Controlled sidebar mode
controlled.description: sidebarMode / onSidebarModeChange control expanded, compact and floating modes; floating expands on hover or keyboard focus.

skip-link.title: Skip link
skip-link.description: A "Skip to content" link is the first focusable element: hidden until focused with the keyboard, it moves focus to main. skipLink takes a custom text, or false to remove it.

AppShellProps.brand: Brand shown at the top of the sidebar (not a page heading)
AppShellProps.brandIcon: Decorative brand icon, still visible in the compact rail
AppShellProps.navigation: Renders the navigation from the current state; rendered in exactly one place (sidebar on desktop, drawer on mobile)
AppShellProps.navigationLabel: Accessible name of the sidebar landmark and title of the mobile drawer
AppShellProps.navigationKey: Change it when a route commits to dismiss the mobile navigation
AppShellProps.headerActions: Content of the top header bar, outside main
AppShellProps.pageNavigation: Rendered between the header and main (e.g. open-page tabs)
AppShellProps.children: Page content, rendered inside the single main landmark
AppShellProps.onSidebarModeChange: Called with the next mode when the user changes it
AppShellProps.labels: Overrides of the control names (localized defaults)
AppShellProps.skipLink: "Skip to content" link rendered as the first focusable element (visually hidden until focused); it moves focus to main. A string replaces its text, false removes it

AppShellNavigationState.collapsed: The desktop sidebar currently shows the compact rail
AppShellNavigationState.isMobile: Navigation is rendered inside the mobile drawer (viewport <= 768px)
AppShellNavigationState.closeNavigation: Closes the mobile navigation drawer (call it when an item is selected)
AppShellNavigationState.expandNavigation: Switches the sidebar to expanded (e.g. when a compact group is opened)

AppShellLabels.expand: Name of the toggle that expands the sidebar
AppShellLabels.collapse: Name of the toggle that collapses the sidebar
AppShellLabels.enableFloating: Name of the pin toggle when floating mode is off
AppShellLabels.disableFloating: Name of the pin toggle when floating mode is on
AppShellLabels.openNavigation: Name of the header button that opens the mobile navigation
AppShellLabels.closeNavigation: Name of the close button of the mobile navigation

cssVars.--app-shell-rail-width: Width of the compact / floating rail
cssVars.--app-shell-header-height: Minimum height of the header and the sidebar brand row
cssVars.--app-shell-sidebar-background: Background of the sidebar and the mobile navigation drawer
cssVars.--app-shell-drawer-width: Width of the mobile navigation drawer

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A sidebar with the brand and the navigation slot, a sticky header (header-actions slot) and the main landmark for the default slot. At 768px and below the navigation moves into a modal drawer opened from the header.

sidebar-modes.title: Sidebar modes and slots
sidebar-modes.description: sidebar-mode="compact" starts with the icon rail; the sidebar buttons expand it or pin it as a floating rail. The collapsed attribute styles the navigation (labels hidden here); brand-icon stays visible in the rail and page-navigation sits between the header and main.

controlled.title: Events, methods and labels
controlled.description: minerva-sidebar-mode-change and minerva-open-change are cancelable (lock the mode to see it). expandNavigation() and focusMain() drive the shell; the *-label and skip-link attributes rename the controls.

props.expandLabel: Name of the toggle that expands the sidebar.
props.collapseLabel: Name of the toggle that collapses the sidebar.
props.enableFloatingLabel: Name of the pin toggle when floating mode is off.
props.disableFloatingLabel: Name of the pin toggle when floating mode is on.
props.openNavigationLabel: Name of the header button that opens the mobile navigation.
props.closeNavigationLabel: Name of the close button of the mobile navigation.
props.mobile: Read-only: the mobile layout is active (viewport of 768px or less).

events.minerva-sidebar-mode-change: The user changed the sidebar mode (detail: { mode }). Cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current mode.
events.minerva-open-change: The mobile drawer opened or closed (detail: { open }). Cancelable when the user asked for it.

slots.default: Page content, inside the main landmark.
slots.navigation: Navigation (sidebar on desktop, drawer on mobile).
slots.brand-icon: Decorative brand icon, still visible in the compact rail.
slots.header-actions: Content of the header bar (account menu, search...).
slots.page-navigation: Rendered between the header and main (e.g. page tabs).

cssVars.--icon-button-color: Icon color of the shell controls (sidebar toggles, menu button).
cssVars.--icon-button-hover-bg: Background of the shell controls on hover.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-color: Icon color of the pressed pin toggle.
cssVars.--icon-button-pressed-bg: Background of the pressed pin toggle.
cssVars.--icon-button-size: Width and height of the shell controls.
cssVars.--icon-button-icon-size: Icon size of the shell controls.
cssVars.--icon-button-radius: Corner radius of the shell controls.

methods.openNavigation: Opens the mobile navigation drawer (mobile layout only).
methods.closeNavigation: Closes the mobile navigation drawer (call it when an item is chosen).
methods.expandNavigation: Switches the sidebar to expanded (e.g. when a group is opened in the compact rail).
methods.focusMain: Moves focus to the main landmark.
